title: Non-Markovian and non-Condon vibrationally assisted electron transfer in an effective ligand--receptor complex
summary: We investigate vibrationally assisted electron transfer in an effective ligand--receptor complex using finite-temperature non-Markovian quantum-state diffusion with explicitly colored environmental noise. The model comprises donor and acceptor electronic states, an explicit bound-ligand vibrational mode, and a Gaussian protein--solvent bath.
